description: Expander for GateSeq64, placed immediately to the right of it; it adds CV inputs for writing gates and probabilities into the sequencer, and works in sequence mode only

inputs.text: Sets the gate state written into the step, so a pattern can be entered from another module
Sets the probability written into the step
A trigger here writes the gate and probability arriving at the other inputs into the step under the cursor and moves the cursor on; with neither of those patched it only moves the cursor on
A trigger here writes an on-gate into the step under the cursor and moves the cursor on
A trigger here writes an off-gate into the step under the cursor and moves the cursor on
A trigger here moves the cursor back one step

notes: it has nothing of its own to set: the connection is made by position, and the panels must touch a GateSeq64 with no gap between them

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
